career_ladder.note: Technical Assistants in the Indian Council of Forestry Research and Education (ICFRE) are appointed across constituent institutes including Forest Research Institute (FRI) Dehradun, Tropical Forest Research Institute (TFRI) Jabalpur, and Institute of Forest Genetics and Tree Breeding (IFGTB) Coimbatore. They provide specialized research and laboratory support in silviculture, forest genetics, pathology, wood anatomy, and agroforestry. Progression is governed by the ICFRE Technical Service Rules (TSR) merit assessment promotion scheme, enabling periodic advancements independent of vacancy constraints.

exam_scheme.note: Recruitment to Technical Assistant in ICFRE institutes is conducted through an All-India Written Examination (OMR / CBT Objective Type) of 100 questions (100 marks) for 120 minutes, followed by Document Verification and Medical Examination.

financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated for Level 5 entry basic pay of ₹29,200. Dearness Allowance at canonical 58% equals ₹16,936. House Rent Allowance ranges from ₹2,920 (10% in Z-class forestry research stations) to ₹8,760 (30% in X-class cities; 20% / ₹5,840 in Y-class cities like Dehradun, Jabalpur, Coimbatore). Transport Allowance ranges from ₹2,844 to ₹5,688. Deductions include NPS 10% (Basic + DA = ₹4,614), medical contribution, and employee insurance.
official_perks: Allotted Type-III residential quarters within ICFRE lush forest estate campuses (e.g., New Forest, Dehradun) or HRA
Field research tour daily allowances and specimen collection travel entitlements
Comprehensive medical treatment at ICFRE institutional hospitals and empanelled CGHS centers
Leave Travel Concession (LTC) and annual leave encashment
Defined contribution benefits under National Pension System (NPS) with 14% government contribution and central gratuity
Children Education Allowance (CEA) per central government rules
